add.k: An NYPD detective who took over Misty's desk
st: Nandi keeps Misty's old desk and clashes with her, then sells Mariah's hideout to Bushmaster and is arrested fleeing with the cash.

files.notes: Named on screen from 2x02 ('Nandi', 'Bailey! Tyler!', springfieldspringfield s02e02). Asks Bushmaster 'Is that offer still good?' in 2x09; caught at the airport and arrested in 2x10. tm moves to Independent at 2x10 because her arrest ends her police service; no new group.

add.k: The boss of the Yardies gang
st: Neville answers Mariah's call to a meeting of crime bosses at Colon's gym and is shot through the neck by Diamondback.
Neville is seen again as Mariah recalls the night Diamondback shot him at Colon's gym, while his brother Nigel now runs the Yardies.

files.notes: Named in 1x09 ('Neville Barnwell with the Yardies', 'Hey, Neville'). 2x01 uses archive footage of the 1x09 massacre (wiki Soul Brother 1 cast: Archive Footage) during Mariah's 'You remember the night at the table at Colon's gym, with his brother' line; the batch's 'flashback with John McIver' is not supported, Bushmaster only says he warned Nigel's brother. Group 'The Yardies' is said on screen; Ciancio says in 2x04 they now go by 'the Stylers' (the app's existing group), so a merge into The Stylers is possible, but Neville never served under that name. He never meets Luke; op/opp set to Luke Cage as Harlem's hero, since his killer Diamondback is himself a villain. Checker: tm set to the app's 'The Stylers', the same gang renamed (2x04).

add.k: The Seagate doctor whose experiment made Luke unbreakable
st: Dr. Burstein's Seagate experiment gives Carl his powers, and years later he saves Luke from Judas shrapnel and visits Diamondback.

files.notes: Named 'Dr. Burstein' in 1x04 ('The prison doctor, Dr. Burstein'); 'Dr. Noah Burstein' in 1x09. He says 'My lab is not my lab anymore' and that Seagate killed the program, so he no longer works there in the present day, but no new group is named; tm kept as Seagate Prison for his service there. Last on screen 1x13 entering Diamondback's guarded room; only mentioned in 2x02.

k: A law student and Lonnie's mother
A Harlem attorney and Lonnie's mother
st: Patricia flirts with Luke at Pop's, finds Lonnie safe after the shooting there, and confronts Ridley when police beat her son.
Now a lawyer, Patricia sits in on Shades's confession, then drops him when she learns his crew shot up Pop's with her son inside.

files.notes: Called 'Counselor' in 1x01; named 'Patty' and 'Patricia' in 1x10 (Mariah: 'Patty, Patty, save your words'; Misty: 'Patricia'), with 'young Lonnie Wilson' in Mariah's speech; 'your attorney, Patricia Wilson' in 2x12. No law firm is named on screen, so tm is Independent.

k: A dirty police lieutenant on Cottonmouth's payroll
st: Perez slips Cottonmouth the seized Hammer guns and feeds him leads on Scarfe, until Misty tricks him into confessing and arrests him.

files.notes: On screen 1x04 to 1x06. Name first said in 1x06 ('I need you and Perez to find our boy'; Cottonmouth: 'Lieutenant Perez'). His work for Cottonmouth is shown from 1x05 (warns Scarfe, arranges the Hammer guns), so the Stokes stage and k are keyed to S1#5. Arrested by Misty at the end of 1x06.

add.k: A Wall Street money man who handles Mariah's fortune
st: Piranha puts Mariah's money in Atreus Plastics and hires Luke as a guard, until Bushmaster makes him empty her accounts and kills him.

files.notes: Named 'Piranha Jones' in 2x01; introduces himself 'Raymond Jones. But you can call me Piranha.' in 2x05; news calls him Raymond "Piranha" Jones in 2x06. Beheaded in 2x07. The wiki's 'Uptown Investments' is never said in the transcripts and I could not confirm it shown, so tm is Independent. Filed A (victim and Luke's client, who never works against the heroes) although the batch guessed villain; he does manage the Stokes money, so T is arguable.

add.k: Mabel's brother-in-law in the Stokes crime family
st: Uncle Pete pushes Cornell toward music and helps him kill Donnie, until Cornell shoots him on Mabel's order for dealing with Colons.
Pete faces Gwen McIver's lawsuit in Jamaica, shoots her young son to avenge Buggy, and taunts Mariah in her visions.

files.notes: Named 'Pistol Pete Stokes' over his photo in 1x06 and 'Uncle Pete' throughout 1x07; on screen only in flashbacks (1x07, 2x11) and as Mariah's vision in 2x11. Shooting young John ('Sorry, coconut... that was for Buggy') is in 2x11. He never faces a hero; op/opp set to Luke Cage as the hero against the Stokes family.

add.k: A Harlem hustler who robs Cottonmouth's gun sale
st: Shameek mouths off at Pop's, robs Cottonmouth's gun sale with Chico, shoots his partner Dante, and is beaten to death by Cottonmouth.

files.notes: Named in 1x01 ('I sweep hair, Shameek'; police: 'Shameek Smith, based on what they found in his pockets'). Seen again in 1x02 and 1x03 flashbacks of the robbery. His crew with Chico and Dante is never named, so tm is Independent. He only spars with Luke at Pop's; op Luke Cage as Harlem's hero.

add.k: Bushmaster's childhood friend and right hand
st: Sheldon plants his cousin at Harlem's Paradise, hunts Piranha for Bushmaster, forces Tilda to heal him, then makes peace with Luke.

files.notes: On screen from 2x01; name first said in 2x04 ('Me, John and our bredren, Sheldon'), then 'And, Sheldon, hear me now' in 2x06. Calls Stephanie 'baby cousin' in 2x03. Visits Luke at Pop's in 2x13 ('Harlem is in the right hands now'). Status At large: never arrested, and not an ally of the heroes.

add.k: A Seagate inmate who befriends Carl Lucas
st: Squabbles stops Carl from killing Comanche, trains him for Rackham's fight ring, and is beaten to death by Shades and Comanche.

files.notes: On screen only in 1x04 (Seagate story). Named in Reva's group: 'Let's start with you, Reggie.' 'In here, I'm Squabbles.' An inmate, so no group (Seagate Prison is his captor, not his group).

k: A new hostess at Harlem's Paradise
st: Stephanie seduces Mark Higgins for Mariah while spying for her cousin Sheldon, until Mariah unmasks her at Gwen's and has her shot.

files.notes: In 2x01: 'You start tomorrow, Billie.' 'Stephanie, ma'am.' 'No, you're Billie.' Full name only after death, from Misty in 2x11 ('Name's Stephanie Miller. Junior at Columbia.'); she is seen again in 2x11 replaying her killing. Her tie to Sheldon is shown in 2x03 ('Baby cousin'); 'Stylers' first said 2x04. She attends Columbia University (said 2x11) but never on screen there. She never faces a hero; op Luke Cage as the hero against both crews.

st: Sugar shakes down Genghis Connie's but runs from Luke, guards hostages in Diamondback's siege, and ends up in a police interview.
Sugar drives for Mariah until he walks out on her march to Gwen's, then becomes Luke's informant and right hand at Harlem's Paradise.

files.notes: On screen from 1x01 but first named in 1x08 (Shades: 'I thought you went back down south, Sugar'). 1x12: Misty watches him in interrogation ('No wonder his street name is Sugar'); his release is not shown. 2x10 walks out ('I ain't doing this'), 2x11 tells Luke Harlem 'needs a king', 2x13 runs Harlem's Paradise floor for Luke. Filed T because most of his time is as a Stokes enforcer; ends Allied. Independent between leaving Mariah (2x10) and Luke taking the club (2x13), as Luke's informant role has no group name.

add.k: A Brooklyn detective who used to work with Misty in Harlem
st: Tomas covers for Misty and Luke at a Yardies warehouse, names John McIver, and later works the Gwen's massacre scene with them.

files.notes: Only his first name is said on screen ('Tomas', 2x04 and 2x11); 'Ciancio' is never said in the transcripts and I could not confirm it shown, so n is 'Tomas'. Misty says 'he and I used to work zombie squad back in Harlem'. On screen 2x04 and 2x11 only.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Nandi has Misty's old desk at the 29th Precinct and refuses to give it back, and the two old teammates snipe at each other on every case. When Nandi sells Mariah out to Bushmaster, Misty chases her down at the airport and confronts her in interrogation.
stages.whoA: Her old high school rival who won't let her work
stages.whoB: The detective who took her desk, then sold out Mariah

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Ridenhour runs the precinct and hands Nandi and Bailey cases like Arturo Rey's murder. After he is shot, Nandi works the scene.
stages.whoA: Her precinct captain
stages.whoB: A detective under his command

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Ridley takes charge of the precinct after Ridenhour's death. Nandi eavesdrops on her talk with Misty about Mariah's immunity deal and uses it to sell Mariah out, and Ridley's people bring her in.
stages.whoA: The chief running her precinct
stages.whoB: A detective who betrays the department

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Nandi visits Bushmaster at Harlem's Paradise with Misty, then goes back alone. She asks if his bounty is still good and gives him Mariah's location for the cash.
stages.whoA: The man who pays her to give up Mariah
stages.whoB: The cop who sells him Mariah's hideout

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Nandi questions Mariah about Mark Higgins and hunts for proof tying her to Ridenhour's death. Convinced Mariah should not win, Nandi sells her location to Bushmaster.
stages.whoA: The crime boss she sells out
stages.whoB: A detective who sells her to Bushmaster

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Neville sits at the table when Diamondback walks into Mariah's meeting at Colon's gym. Neville tells him to ease up, but Diamondback shoots him and another boss with a single bullet.
stages.whoA: The arms dealer who shoots him
stages.whoB: A Yardies boss he kills at Colon's gym

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Mariah calls Harlem's crime bosses, Neville among them, to Colon's gym to sell off Cottonmouth's business. The meeting ends when Diamondback kills Neville and the others.
stages.whoA: The councilwoman who calls the bosses together
stages.whoB: A rival boss at her Colon's gym meeting

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Domingo gathers the bosses for Mariah, naming Neville with the Yardies among those invited. Diamondback spares Domingo but kills Neville at the table.
stages.whoA: A rival boss who sets up the meeting
stages.whoB: The Yardies boss he invites to the table

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: At Seagate, Dr. Burstein puts a dying Carl Lucas in his experimental bath, and the blast leaves him unbreakable. Years later Luke and Claire bring him the Judas shrapnel, and Burstein repeats the bath to save him, but Luke smashes his lab when Burstein keeps calling him Carl.
stages.whoA: The doctor whose experiment made him
stages.whoB: The test subject he made unbreakable

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Claire brings a dying Luke to Burstein and helps him recreate the Seagate bath. When Luke's heart stops, Claire shocks him back to life as Burstein watches.
stages.whoA: The nurse who helps him save Luke
stages.whoB: The scientist she helps save Luke

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Reva works with Dr. Burstein at Seagate and brings him the beaten Carl Lucas, begging him to save his life. Her stolen hard drive later gives Burstein back all his lost research.
stages.whoA: The Seagate counselor who worked beside him
stages.whoB: The prison doctor she brings Carl to

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: After Luke beats Diamondback, Burstein comes to the guarded hospital room where he lies wounded. He smiles at the officer and shuts the door to talk with him alone.
stages.whoA: The wounded prisoner he visits
stages.whoB: The doctor who comes to see him

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Patty flirts with Luke at Pop's and leaves him her number, joking he may need a lawyer one day. When the shop is shot up, Luke shields her son Lonnie from the bullets.
stages.whoA: The barbershop sweeper she has her eye on
stages.whoB: Lonnie's mom, a flirt at Pop's

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Pop cuts Lonnie's hair and teases Patty as Counselor before she has passed the bar. He dies in the shooting at his shop while Lonnie is in the chair.
stages.whoA: Her son's barber and an old friend
stages.whoB: Lonnie's mother, the future lawyer

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: After police beat Lonnie in custody, Mariah marches into the precinct with Patricia. Mariah uses Lonnie's beating to rally Harlem against the police and Luke.
stages.whoA: The councilwoman who takes up her cause
stages.whoB: A furious mother she brings to the precinct

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: At the precinct Misty asks how Lonnie is, and Patricia tells her to keep her son's name out of her mouth.
stages.whoA: A detective she blames for her son's beating
stages.whoB: Lonnie's angry mother

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Misty takes Shades's confession with Patricia as his attorney. When Patricia learns of the barbershop shooting, she recuses herself and leaves Misty to finish.
stages.whoA: The detective taking her client's confession
stages.whoB: Shades's lawyer, until she walks out

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Patricia is assigned as Shades's attorney for his confession against Mariah. When he admits Cottonmouth's crew shot up Pop's, where her son nearly died, she drops him and tells him to burn in hell.
stages.whoA: The client she drops in disgust
stages.whoB: His lawyer, who quits on him

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Perez works the hunt for Scarfe beside Misty while secretly feeding Cottonmouth. Misty fakes a call from Scarfe, Perez blurts out his guilt, and she makes him cuff himself.
stages.whoA: The detective who tricks and arrests him
stages.whoB: The dirty lieutenant she exposes

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Perez is on Cottonmouth's payroll and arranges the stolen Hammer guns for him. While hunting Scarfe, he tells Cottonmouth about the van seen at Pop's.
stages.whoA: The crime boss who pays him
stages.whoB: His man inside the police

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Perez and Scarfe are both on Cottonmouth's payroll. Perez warns Scarfe that Internal Affairs is onto him and passes on Cottonmouth's order to move the guns, then hunts him once he runs.
stages.whoA: A fellow dirty cop
stages.whoB: The lieutenant who shares his secret

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Piranha has known Mariah since he was a kid and runs her money, steering her into the Atreus Plastics deal with power of attorney over her assets. Bushmaster forces him to move all of it out of her accounts.
stages.whoA: The client whose fortune he runs
stages.whoB: Her Wall Street money man

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Piranha, a huge fan, hires Luke to stand guard at his party. When the Stylers attack, Luke hides him in an old theater and at his father's church, but Bushmaster's men still take him.
stages.whoA: The hero he hires as his bodyguard
stages.whoB: A fan who hires him, then gets taken

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Bushmaster's men take Piranha and hold him while Bushmaster makes him type in the codes to Mariah's money. Then Bushmaster has him beheaded.
stages.whoA: The man who takes Mariah's money and his life
stages.whoB: Mariah's money man, made to drain her

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Shades sits in as Piranha pitches Mariah the Atreus Plastics deal. He is at Piranha's party when the Stylers attack.
stages.whoA: Mariah's right hand on the deal
stages.whoB: Mariah's Wall Street money man

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Foggy comes with Luke to Piranha's office and bargains Luke's fee up to $150,000 for one night as a bodyguard.
stages.whoA: Luke's lawyer, who sets the fee
stages.whoB: The fan paying Luke to guard him

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Sheldon calls on Luke to give up the little guppy and sends men all over Harlem after Piranha. They finally take him for Bushmaster.
stages.whoA: The Stylers man hunting him
stages.whoB: The money man he hunts

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Uncle Pete pays for young Cornell's piano lessons and wants him out of the life, but takes him along to kill Donnie. When Mabel learns Pete is dealing with the Colons, Cornell shoots him.
stages.whoA: The great-nephew who shoots him
stages.whoB: The uncle he loved, then killed

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Mariah tells Pete he deserves what is coming as Cornell holds him at gunpoint. Pete brushes off what he did to her as a game.
stages.whoA: The great-niece he abused
stages.whoB: The uncle she wanted dead

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Pete appears in Mariah's mind beside Mabel as she plans her revenge. He praises how he molded her and calls Tilda their daughter, and she orders him to keep Tilda's name out of his mouth.
stages.whoA: The great-niece he still haunts
stages.whoB: The uncle who haunts her

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: After the Stokes family burns Gwen McIver's home, Pete tracks her son John to a Jamaican market. He shoots the boy and leaves him for dead, saying it is for Buggy.
stages.whoA: The boy he shoots for Buggy
stages.whoB: The Stokes gunman who shot him as a boy

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Shameek robs Cottonmouth's gun sale at the junkyard. Tone brings him to Harlem's Paradise, he spits in Cottonmouth's face, and Cottonmouth beats him to death.
stages.whoA: The crime boss he robs
stages.whoB: The thief he beats to death

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Tone finds Shameek celebrating at a strip club and drags him to Cottonmouth, then gets rid of his body.
stages.whoA: The thug who hauls him in
stages.whoB: The robber he brings to Cottonmouth

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: At Pop's, Shameek needles Luke about sweeping floors, then backs down when Luke stares him down.
stages.whoA: The quiet sweeper he picks at
stages.whoB: A loudmouth at Pop's

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Shameek hangs out at Pop's while Chico cuts his hair, and Pop teases him about his basketball dreams. After his death, Pop works to keep Chico from ending up the same way.
stages.whoA: The barber who knows him well
stages.whoB: A loud regular at his shop

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Sheldon grew up with John in Jamaica and follows him to New York as his right hand. He films Luke's fights for Bushmaster to study, carries him to Tilda when he is dying, and sends him home to Jamaica.
stages.whoA: His childhood friend and the crew's leader
stages.whoB: His bredren and right hand

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Sheldon has his cousin Stephanie take a job at Harlem's Paradise to spy on Mariah, and tells her to hold on when she wants to quit. He weeps when he learns she was killed at Gwen's.
stages.whoA: His cousin, spying for him
stages.whoB: Her cousin, who sent her in

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Sheldon brings the dying Bushmaster to Tilda and warns her that if he dies, she dies. She heals him, turns on her mother, and Sheldon thanks her before he leaves.
stages.whoA: The doctor he forces to heal Bushmaster
stages.whoB: Bushmaster's man who first threatens her

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Sheldon tells Luke to release Piranha or face war, and his men take Piranha from him. Once Mariah is gone, Sheldon walks into Pop's to say Harlem is in the right hands now.
stages.whoA: The hero he fights, then respects
stages.whoB: Bushmaster's right hand

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Sheldon helps Bushmaster burn Mariah's brownstone and seize Harlem's Paradise, then joins the attack to drag her out of hiding. Mariah's men kill his cousin at Gwen's.
stages.whoA: The Stokes woman they want dead
stages.whoB: Bushmaster's right hand

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: At Seagate, Squabbles keeps reaching out to the silent Carl Lucas and stops him from killing Comanche. He coaches Carl in Rackham's fight ring and dies refusing to give him up.
stages.whoA: His friend from Seagate
stages.whoB: The inmate who coached him and died for it

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Squabbles sits in Reva's group sessions, where he says Reggie had a life but in here he is Squabbles. Reva begs him to tell her about Carl, but he keeps his friend's secrets.
stages.whoA: The counselor who runs his group
stages.whoB: An inmate in her group

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Rackham's men frame Squabbles to force Carl into the fights. When Carl plans to expose the ring, Shades and Comanche beat Squabbles until he talks, and he dies.
stages.whoA: One of the inmates who beat him to death
stages.whoB: The inmate he beats for Rackham

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Squabbles stops Carl from beating Comanche to death. Later Comanche and Shades beat Squabbles in his cell until he dies.
stages.whoA: Comanche, who helps kill him
stages.whoB: The inmate who once saved him from Carl

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Mariah hires Stephanie as a hostess, renames her Billie, and uses her to seduce Mark Higgins for blackmail. At Gwen's, Mariah realizes Billie has been spying for Bushmaster and has her shot.
stages.whoA: The boss she spies on, who kills her
stages.whoB: The hostess who betrayed her

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Stephanie feeds Bushmaster's crew what she learns at Harlem's Paradise, including word about Piranha. When Bushmaster takes the club, she greets him with a kiss on the cheek.
stages.whoA: The man she spies for
stages.whoB: A spy inside Mariah's club

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Luke breaks up Zip's shakedown of Genghis Connie's, and one of Zip's crew runs rather than fight him, saying he doesn't even like the others.
stages.whoA: The hero he won't fight
stages.whoB: A Stokes thug who runs from him

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Sugar feeds Luke tips while driving for Mariah, then walks out on her and tells Luke Harlem needs a king. Luke makes him his right hand at Harlem's Paradise.
stages.whoA: The hero he ends up working for
stages.whoB: His informant and right hand

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: One of Cottonmouth's enforcers sits splattered with Koko's blood when Cottonmouth shoots Koko, then is sent out to collect the Luke Cage stupidity tax.
stages.whoA: The boss who gave him a job
stages.whoB: One of his street enforcers

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Sugar follows Mariah around the park as Cottonmouth's bodyguard and stays on when she takes over.
stages.whoA: The councilwoman he guards
stages.whoB: Cottonmouth's muscle, now hers

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Sugar drives Mariah and lends her his wife's clothes after her home burns, but quits when she marches Anansi to Gwen's. Mariah spares him when she cleans house.
stages.whoA: The boss he finally walks out on
stages.whoB: The driver she spares

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: After Cottonmouth's death, Shades tells Sugar and Zip they work for him now, and keeps him on through Diamondback's siege of Harlem's Paradise.
stages.whoA: The enforcer who takes charge of him
stages.whoB: One of his crew

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Shades posts Sugar to guard the back of Harlem's Paradise during the gang war.
stages.whoA: Mariah's right hand
stages.whoB: A guard at the club

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Zip and a fellow enforcer guard Mariah in the park and shake down the Lins together. Luke knocks Zip down while his partner flees.
stages.whoA: His partner in Cottonmouth's crew
stages.whoB: A fellow enforcer

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Misty calls her old squad partner Tomas to cover for her at a Brooklyn warehouse, and he tells her about the Stylers and John McIver. At Gwen's he lets her stay on the scene and checks the casings with her.
stages.whoA: His old partner, now Harlem's favorite detective
stages.whoB: Her old squad partner in Brooklyn

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Tomas meets Luke at the warehouse and recognizes Bushmaster's photo as John McIver. At Gwen's he tells Luke to leave the scene and that police cannot pin it on Mariah yet.
stages.whoA: The hero who keeps showing up at his scenes
stages.whoB: A Brooklyn detective who helps

changes.why: Same group under the app's name: Shades says Bushmaster 'took over the Yardies' and Tomas says 'They don't go by the Yardies anymore... going by the Stylers', calling Nigel Garrison's killing 'an internal Styler beef'; the app files Bushmaster under The Stylers.

By the present day the Seagate program is gone: 'they killed the whole thing', 'During the cover-up, I stole whatever I could', 'My lab is not my lab anymore'; he works alone from his own place, so his Seagate service has ended.

changes.was: [["Lonnie's mother", "Luke Cage S1"], ["Patricia Wilson", "Luke Cage S1#10"]]
changes.now: [["Patty", "Luke Cage S1"], ["Patricia", "Luke Cage S1#10"], ["Patricia Wilson", "Luke Cage S2#12"]]
changes.why: Pop names her in 1x01 ('Give Patty a call. She's a good woman.'), so she is not unnamed; 1x10 says only 'Patricia' (her surname is said only as Lonnie's), and 'your attorney, Patricia Wilson' is first said in 2x12.

changes.why: This stage is episode 2; by then she is only called Patty (1x01). 'Patricia' is first said in 1x10.

changes.now: Pop cuts Lonnie's hair and teases Patty as Counselor before she has passed the bar. He dies in the shooting at his shop while Lonnie is in the chair.
changes.why: This stage is episode 2; by then she is only called Patty (1x01). 'Patricia' is first said in 1x10.

changes.was: Luke breaks up Zip's shakedown of Genghis Connie's, and Sugar runs rather than fight him, saying he doesn't even like the others.
changes.now: Luke breaks up Zip's shakedown of Genghis Connie's, and one of Zip's crew runs rather than fight him, saying he doesn't even like the others.
changes.why: This stage is episode 1; Sugar's name is first said in 1x08 (Shades: 'I thought you went back down south, Sugar'), so he is unnamed here.

changes.was: Sugar and Zip guard Mariah in the park and shake down the Lins together. Luke knocks Zip down while Sugar flees.
changes.now: Zip and a fellow enforcer guard Mariah in the park and shake down the Lins together. Luke knocks Zip down while his partner flees.
changes.why: This stage is episode 1; Sugar's name is first said in 1x08 (Shades: 'I thought you went back down south, Sugar'), so he is unnamed here.
